source_scope: Official upstream legacy aapt output grammar, corroborating exact observed S42 bytes. This does not claim the installed Debian binary was built from this upstream revision.

rules.source_branch: Immediately after the manifest package row, installLocation is switched among 0/1/2 for auto/internalOnly/preferExternal; other values emit stderr and bail.
rules.bounded_parser_rule: One whole-line enum row immediately following the package row; unknown values, suffixes, duplicates and other placement remain unrecognized.

rules.source_branch: printFeatureGroupImpl emits the group header, then one positive openGLESVersion in hexadecimal, then the feature and implied-feature rows.
rules.bounded_parser_rule: Exactly two spaces as in actual output; canonical positive lowercase hex fitting signed int32, inside the active group before its feature rows, at most once. It preserves the group for following recognized feature rows.

rules.source_branch: The positive requiresSmallestWidthDp integer is emitted immediately after supports-any-density, before optional width limits and locales.
rules.bounded_parser_rule: One canonical positive decimal fitting signed int32 immediately after the exact boolean density row; unknown/malformed/out-of-context values remain unrecognized.

retained_main_marker_rule: The prior strict contextual bare-main rule is retained. Official hasMainActivity prints bare main after feature groups; no launchable component is inferred from that marker.
